base.role: CUDA 13.0.3, PyTorch and vendor runtime libraries only. SGLang (with its Rust extensions), FlashInfer with its cubin bundle and DeepGEMM are rebuilt from the sources below.

patches.note: #42919 stacks its one commit on #40453, which merged as 6e8f3e09dd; only that commit is carried.

patches.head: f415e581e9e92eef014d16b7e240b9d93c25a564
patches.purpose: Fill each rank's host-resident Engram rows with parallel positioned reads instead of faulting a memory map.

patches.head: 2f2173c1191ad4da45fcd3046d025c6ba3707a2b
patches.purpose: Run the V4.1 candidate indexer on SM12x through the paged decode path.

patches.purpose: Map packed compact-verify tokens to their requests for Engram hashing (replaces sgl-project/sglang#40567).
patches.note: #42709, which the PR used to carry, is in main.

patches.head: 0c2039fbd203307f23b1ef9ca0016f052b4328cc
patches.purpose: Apply a pinned DSpark verify budget while the SPS table is uninitialized.

patches.head: 7555629fc82616a54f52f487410f8710e8275e9d

patches.head: e0d579ed86dbc7d219eec67faa009e75f2133d0f
patches.purpose: Every TP rank resolves the same relayed DSpark confidence (no rank-local readiness check, no unordered buffer overwrite).

patches.head: 8ee1d044df0982f4d0f0843010c4f2748242ed92
patches.purpose: Forced-uniform compact verify captures key by token count and carry a full-width layout, matching replay.

patches.head: d78457690b505e2c6f34b4cadecfc650a58c414e
patches.purpose: DSpark STS calibration labels come from the actual acceptance, with unverified positions masked out.
patches.note: Main (#43790) passes confidence_raw to the step observers: the STS recorder takes it from the caller and labels with correct_len.

patches.head: 225456869446df1962d764687511f62cefecbe07
patches.purpose: Decode FP4 index keys without exp2 in the Triton scorer (bit-identical).

patches.head: b2182fc605fb2752bec49dd1e451134aed09872c
patches.purpose: Split-K MXFP8 GEMM for tuned decode-sized linears at up to 16 rows (SGLANG_ENABLE_SM120_MXFP8_SKINNY_GEMM, default on).

patches.head: 74c736c8acf144b299243c932917488c1f963b69
patches.purpose: Vectorized mHC split-K reduce; 160 K slices for SM120 decode and verify.

patches.head: e60bfae9dea176fedf14a45d6c1b9108c2bba6c5
patches.purpose: Wide prefill computes the mHC mix stats while the TP all-reduce runs again (restores the overlap #42245 removed).

patches.head: cac55f52a3f5f2b4cc7637de7e2bb80b425e1c97
patches.purpose: TP4 logits and DSpark vocab all-gathers use FlashInfer's PCIe-IPC all-gather where its all-reduce is enabled (SGLANG_ENABLE_PCIE_IPC_ALLREDUCE).

patches.head: 0d74e2e57f8947b8475d69a04690847616282808
patches.purpose: Opt-in weight-streaming BF16 GEMM for LM heads at up to 16 rows (SGLANG_ENABLE_BF16_SKINNY_LM_HEAD); batch-invariant rows.
patches.note: Registered with main's slimmer KernelSpec (#44690); the environment variable moves to the logits section.

patches.head: cc4a0fad757850c480bbc0ad2aa954d5be2f88c1
patches.purpose: --warmups serving_coverage drives real requests through every serving path before the server accepts traffic, including concurrent decodes at every power-of-two batch size up to the running-request limit (replaces the carried decode_batches warmup).

patches.head: 1d4778b0855ab2f1f99b30cdca6b1d4fc5e8cd18
patches.reason: The branch head moved to 7957c5eadf (rebased on main 5cbf949839; the fit prices padding tokens of the executed tier and a failed measurement keeps the configured table only once the schedulers confirm its end). CPU-tested (63 tests); the upstream PR is posted with GPU measurements.
patches.purpose: --speculative-dspark-sps-autotune off|auto|force: fit the DSpark SPS cost table at startup from real decode steps per (batch size, verify tier) plus a per-verify-token context term, cached per configuration (no manual profiling step).

patches.head: 3285a778f121affe4ddc364ecaa431b561fce3ee
patches.reason: Restored opt-in (SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_SUB_WIDTH_TIERS, off unless the deployment sets it): 0.2.0 ran with it; #43011 was closed on a single-sample measurement. The deployment A/B decides.
patches.purpose: Opt-in ragged-verify token tiers below one request's width (SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_SUB_WIDTH_TIERS).

patches.head: 6e78b53e128a470e2eab5e75ed6a5714c604fab7
patches.purpose: Skip top-p renormalization on compact-verify padding rows (Triton fill of the padding rows instead of a gathered copy).

patches.head: c7210cb557e70665e1b876b9b163bf415bce1c4f
patches.purpose: Compact verify hands self-adding backends committed CPU lengths, as static verify does.

patches.head: 103ad321d2f870c191dc71d470a375d0a51e9170
patches.purpose: Paged decode consumer layers score only their candidate blocks.
patches.note: Carried rebased on main (local d8c0802f75); open #40860 implements the same candidate scoring for paged decode and prefill.

patches.head: 465a8cc6f90bd60116a935fe581cb0f25942ac3d
patches.purpose: SM120 decode/verify WO-A reads an exact FP8 copy of its BF16 weight (SGLANG_DSV41_WO_A_FP8_COPY, default on).
patches.note: main's unified FP8 q-pair test stub sets wo_a_fp8_weight.

patches.head: aec7e5c2091ed685d22c70b89bf72c5c3e924e12
patches.purpose: Under encoder SWA bounded replay, the image warmup runs on CUDA, where replay carries image inputs.
patches.note: Main carries image inputs through encoder replay on CUDA (#45048), so the PR is reduced to warming up the image path under encoder SWA bounded replay on CUDA.

patches.head: b7b433967d7e18bb3892a17cc5724972bbd129a3
patches.purpose: DSv4.1 prefill indexer score tiles sized by memory in use (when free memory alone would leave tiles of fewer than 256 rows, the caching allocator's unused blocks are returned and it is read again), with their scratch counted and no padded copy: the OOM fix without shrinking tiles on a long-running server.
patches.note: Free memory alone left out the allocator's cache, so on a running server deep chunks fell to tiles of a few rows (0.4.2-0.4.3); a fixed tile pool was measured and rejected (it starves the MoE workspace or costs ~500 KV tokens per MiB).

patches.head: 76b72f7b33f9a444b17daf90d9cfc507e5728d2a
patches.reason: Reviewed (Codex) and CPU-tested. Recorded C1 sessions on rc18 show the host planner sizes each step from confidences two steps old; a per-request running average models +1.2% (short context) and +2.7% (143K) at C1, no change at C2/C4. Enabled in the deployment with SGLANG_DSPARK_BUDGET_SURVIVAL_EMA.
patches.purpose: DSpark host budget planner sizes each step from a per-request running average of the lagged survival (opt-in); request-pool generations stay unique across a pool clear.

patches.head: d5c5cca6dee0f1e9f1f69e9be965da359d0b3818
patches.purpose: DSpark read_accept returns copies, not views of the buffers the next verify replay rewrites, so TP ranks commit the same token counts under the overlap scheduler with HiCache. Amended for main with #43790: the in-graph accept writes the static buffers through _accept_buffers (PR head 7a8f74963c9d made it write into read_accept copies, so commit_lens read back as 0 and 0.4.0-rc.2 crashed on a negative correct-draft count).
patches.note: #42812's head now writes the in-graph accept into the static buffers (accept_buffers), the amendment the image carried; carried unchanged.

patches.head: 869dd28f7ecb6e75be8322e0bf3a293422b25442
patches.purpose: The OpenAI routes return errors as {"error": {message, type, param, code}}; error.type follows the HTTP status; the serving catch-all 500 no longer includes exception text.

patches.head: 4dbfee9ac2818b67200bdcb19351c8da3c3d3530
patches.purpose: Chat and completions never report finish_reason "abort": an abort with an error status returns that error, one without is reported as "stop"; grammar rejections abort with 500.
patches.note: #45132 stacks its commit on #45130; only that commit is carried.

patches.head: 78c7fa887861f6d2054010de334dac72768fecdd
patches.purpose: Chat and completion streams that fail after the first chunk end with an error frame and [DONE]; non-ValueError exceptions are reported without their text.
patches.note: #45133 stacks its commit on #45130; only that commit is carried.

patches.head: 135f8ec203d689bad575ca185bd7e498143f05e7
patches.purpose: The MXFP4 CUTLASS MoE passes FlashInfer one persistent workspace_buffer per device and stream, sized by cutlass_fused_moe_workspace_size, instead of letting it allocate and free about 1 GiB of scratch on every call, which on a running server went through the caching allocator's OOM retry on every prefill chunk.

packaging.rationale: SGLang main pins the published FlashInfer 0.7.2; FlashInfer main is 0.7.2 with no wheel published for that commit, so its pin is kept at the same version and the cubin bundle is built from the same commit (its downloader verifies the source-pinned checksum manifest). DeepGEMM is sgl-project's v0.2.3.post2 tag on release/v0.2.3, the sgl-deep-gemm 0.2.3.post2 SGLang main pins, with a local commit suffix: it keeps the SM120 MQA-logits kernels and the fp8_fp4_mqa_logits signature SGLang main calls, which the dev branch has removed and changed. typeguard 4 repairs the vendor base's typeguard conflict, Pillow stays at the vendor's patched >=12.3, NCCL keeps the vendor's deliberate 2.30.7 floor, and MoviePy is an unused diffusion extra whose Pillow<12 bound would downgrade the decoder.

allowed_conflicts: The package `cosmos-guardrail` requires `imageio>=2.37.0`, but `2.36.0` is installed
The package `cosmos-guardrail` requires `opencv-python>=4.10.0.84`, but it's not installed
The package `retinaface-py` requires `opencv-python`, but it's not installed
The package `nixl` requires `nixl-cu12==1.5.1`, but it's not installed
The package `ai-dynamo-runtime` requires `pydantic>=2.10.6,<=2.13.5`, but `2.14.1` is installed
dependency_gate.rationale: The vendor base deliberately substitutes headless OpenCV, CUDA 13 NIXL and NCCL 2.30.7, and SGLang's diffusion extra pins imageio 2.36.0. The vendor base ships ai-dynamo-runtime (NVIDIA Dynamo, never imported by SGLang) with pydantic 2.14.1; this build changes neither package. Every other `uv pip check` result fails the build.

added_dependencies.name: instanttensor
added_dependencies.reason: Runtime backend of the InstantTensor loader (sgl-project/sglang#40453, in main; SGLang lists instanttensor>=0.1.9 only in its test extra). Its only requirement, torch>=2.8.0, is already met; installed without resolution and hash-checked.

hardware.interconnect: PCIe across NUMA nodes; no NVLink

flashinfer_patches.head: 447f21aed04c67cdbe2f21d9d58e3c8ce4441e9a
flashinfer_patches.purpose: SM120 MXFP8 GEMM calls without a tuned tactic use the swap-AB 128x32 tile (several times faster at decode M, same bits).

triton_patches.head: 0d564c5bbf5f24ccf39fc28f9d7c44f58a50adb5
triton_patches.purpose: Backport of main's dot-operand rematerialization fix: Triton 3.8.0 (#11108, issue #11526) sends tf32x3 dot operands through extra shared-memory round trips (2-3x slower pipelined split-K on SM120).
